# PowerLaw_Exponent_Analysis

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The statistical fitting of avalanche size and duration distributions to power-law models to quantify the brain's critical state in sleep EEG. Offers a computationally lightweight feature extraction method suitable for on-chip implementation in neuromorphic processors for real-time EEG analysis.
